capabilities: Track local AI agent sessions in a sidebar
Delegate tasks to agents from note lines
Show agent status in the macOS menu bar
Review token usage with a heatmap dashboard
Turn notes into fractal kanban boards
extras: Desktop only (no mobile); Windows partially adapted (no menu bar, terminal handoff, or desktop session tracking). Local-first: reads local session files without uploading; open source under Apache 2.0. Delegation needs local agent clients and cannot run via remote API; the in-Obsidian conversation view is read-only. Requires Obsidian 1.4.0+ desktop.
problem: AI coding agent sessions are scattered across separate clients, so it is hard to see which agent is running, waiting, or finished from inside Obsidian.
